project_context.name: Archi
project_context.theme: Sci-Fi HUD, Iron-Man Jarvis interface, Dark, Cinematic, Futuristic
project_context.core_loop: User interacts via voice/text with a central immersive visualizer representing the AI's state (idle, listening, thinking, speaking) while surrounding HUD panels display memory and chat.
project_context.persona_notes: Archi has a female voice via Web Speech API and specifically addresses the user as 'daddy'.

rules.headings: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Uppercase and wide spacing for overlines/labels (tracking-[0.2em]).
rules.body: Loose leading (leading-relaxed) for chat transcript readability. Tech-heavy monospace feel.
rules.hierarchy: H1: text-5xl to text-6xl clamp. H2: text-3xl. Body: text-sm to text-base. Labels: text-xs tracking-widest.

rules.backgrounds: Never use pure black #000000. Always use the tinted Void Black (#030508).
rules.gradients: Avoid generic SaaS gradients. Use flat dark surfaces with heavy inner/outer drop shadows to create a neon 'glow' effect.
rules.contrast: Text over HUD must pass minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Use text-shadow to isolate neon text from background visuals.

hud_panels.style: Retro-Futurism Terminal Look mixed with Crystal Glass
hud_panels.css_classes: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#030508]/60 border border-[#00F0FF]/30 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.1)] rounded-none
hud_panels.rules: No pure transparent backgrounds if content scrolls underneath. Must have glass blur to maintain legibility.

buttons.css_classes: bg-transparent border border-[#00F0FF]/50 text-[#00F0FF] hover:bg-[#00F0FF]/10 hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)] transition-colors duration-300
buttons.active_state: For Push-to-Talk: pulsing scale animation, bright solid background.

layouts.main_container: h-screen w-full relative overflow-hidden bg-[#030508] flex items-center justify-center
layouts.visualizer_layer: absolute inset-0 z-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none
layouts.hud_layer: absolute inset-0 z-10 p-4 md:p-8 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 pointer-events-none

hud_children.chat_panel: pointer-events-auto col-span-1 md:col-span-3 flex flex-col h-full max-h-full overflow-hidden
hud_children.memory_panel: pointer-events-auto col-span-1 md:col-span-3 md:col-start-10 flex flex-col h-full max-h-full overflow-hidden
hud_children.control_bar: pointer-events-auto col-span-full absolute bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex gap-4 items-center bg-[#030508]/80 backdrop-blur-md px-6 py-3 border border-[#00F0FF]/40 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.2)]

rules.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-6 inside HUD panels. Use optical alignment.
rules.alignment: Strict grid logic for panels. Visualizer is perfectly centered to create absolute symmetry.

visualizer_states.idle: Gentle pulse, slow rotation, low opacity ambient glow.
visualizer_states.listening: Expansion/contraction on audio input, dynamic scaling, intense glowing rings.
visualizer_states.thinking: Fast processing rotation, erratic particle movement, shifting accent colors.
visualizer_states.speaking: Synchronized scaling and color bursts matching TTS audio levels.

ui_transitions.panels: Slide in from screen edges with slight blur reveal (using framer-motion).
ui_transitions.hover: Targeted text color shift + box-shadow glow increase.

motion_and_interactions.rules: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Exclude transforms from universal transitions. Use custom snappy curves.

components.name: VisualizerEngine
components.instructions: Use React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber). Accept a 'state' prop ('idle', 'listening', 'thinking', 'speaking') and 'mode' prop ('orb', 'circuit'). 'orb': glowing sphere with custom shader material/particles. 'circuit': flat plane with glowing tech grid nodes and central text 'ARCHI'.

components.name: HudPanel
components.instructions: Wrapper for sidebar items (Chat, Memory). Must include scanning line overlay and glowing border. Needs scrollable interior area without default scrollbars (hide gutter).

components.name: AudioController
components.instructions: Push to talk button and mute/settings toggles. Needs glowing radiating rings when 'listening'. Integrate Lucide icons (e.g., Mic, Settings, Volume).

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='push-to-talk-button', data-testid='face-style-toggle', data-testid='chat-input').
accessibility.contrast: Neon text must be highly legible against backgrounds. Use shadows if necessary.

hud_background.description: Dynamic abstract neon grid. Use with very low opacity (5-10%) and blend-mode as the deepest background layer.

scanline_texture.description: Abstract pattern of glowing lines. Use as a masked texture over HUD panels with mix-blend-mode: overlay.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic on-distribution outputs. The UI must feel like a premium sci-fi movie HUD (Jarvis/Iron Man).
Dark colors must be used independently without generic linear gradients.
Do not apply universal 'transition: all' in CSS. Target specific properties.
Do not center align the app container text by default; use optical alignment.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop-blur-xl and subtle saturated borders for HUD panels.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖 or 🧠 for icons. Use clean SVG icons.
Incorporate 3D via @react-three/fiber for the central face, as a 2D DOM element will not capture the 'living circuit board / orb' requirement effectively.
Ensure all settings controls (voice toggle, face style switch, mute) are clearly accessible in the main UI.
